leadText: Battle of the Advanced Generation (Chinese: 超世代之戰 Chīu Saidoih jī Jin) is the fourth opening theme of the Cantonese dub of . Despite being based on Advance Adventure, it was used from near the end of the Johto saga at EP260 until AG089. It was the last of the Cantonese themes to be used in the animated series until being followed up by A Magical Land in Pokémon the Series: Black & White.

Battle of the Advanced Generation (Chinese: 超世代之戰 Chīu Saidoih jī Jin) is the fourth opening theme of the Cantonese dub of . Despite being based on Advance Adventure, it was used from near the end of the Johto saga at EP260 until AG089. It was the last of the Cantonese themes to be used in the animated series until being followed up by A Magical Land in Pokémon the Series: Black & White.
